title: Welcome to the DNIHS Library
content: The library is open from 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday to Friday. Browse the catalog, borrow a book, or leave a note on the Freedom Wall. Welcome back, readers!

title: Book Week 2026: Read. Reflect. Rise.
content: Join us for Book Week from November 16–20. Activities include a bookmark-making contest, a poetry reading corner, and a book swap. Sign up at the circulation desk.

title: New Arrivals: Self-Help and Philosophy
content: Fresh copies of Atomic Habits, Meditations, and The Way of Zen are now available. Visit the new arrivals shelf near the entrance.

title: Overdue Reminder
content: Please return overdue books before the end of the quarter. Check your loan history or ask the library staff for help.
